settings.privacy.subtitle: What's private, what we can see, and how we protect it.
settings.privacy.body: Your captures, drafts, and signals are private to your account — no other user can see them, and nothing in KnownBy shows them to us. We don't sell your data, and the providers that power KnownBy operate under business terms that don't use it to train their models by default. KnownBy isn't end-to-end encrypted — the system has to read your content to turn it into signals — so we protect it with strict per-account isolation instead.

gj.title: Tell KnownBy who you are
gj.intro: You've spent years building expertise. This is where KnownBy learns what makes you different — so everything it does reflects your knowledge, your voice, your sector.
gj.s1.title: Your professional profile
gj.s1.why: Every signal KnownBy detects is filtered through your sector and expertise. Without knowing who you are, KnownBy is reading blind — it can't tell the difference between noise and the patterns that matter to YOUR career.
gj.s2.title: Brand assessment
gj.s2.why: Ten questions, five minutes. Influenced by established professional methods — behavioural anchoring for strengths, archetype method from brand work, and the search for uncontested space in strategy. Nothing is scored. It shapes everything KnownBy does for you from this point forward.
gj.s3.title: Save a few articles (optional)
gj.s3.why: Save a few articles from your sector. Your first signal could appear after just one — and it gets stronger with each one you add. You can also teach KnownBy your writing voice from My Story later.
gj.done: Setup complete. Your full Story view is below.
